Author: Satendra Rajput
Organization: KudoEngineer
Introduction
Modern web applications rely on timely and meaningful feedback to create a great user experience. Whether it’s confirming that data has been saved, notifying users of an error, or displaying important information, toast notifications have become an essential part of every application.
While working on several Angular projects, I noticed that many toast libraries either include unnecessary dependencies, offer limited customization, or don’t fully embrace the latest Angular features. That inspired me to build @kudoengineer/toast — a lightweight, modern, and developer-friendly toast notification library designed specifically for Angular 22+.
This package marks the beginning of the KudoEngineer open-source ecosystem.
Press enter or click to view image in full size

Why I Built This Package
My objective was simple:

• Build a lightweight notification library.

• Use the latest Angular architecture.

• Keep the API clean and intuitive.

• Minimize setup time.

• Make it suitable for production applications.
Instead of adding complexity, I wanted developers to install the package and start showing notifications within minutes.
Key Features
The library includes features commonly required in modern Angular applications:

• Standalone Component Support

• Angular Signals

• Tree-Shakable Architecture

• Multiple Toast Types

• Queue Management

• Auto Close

• Progress Bar

• Close Button

• Custom Duration

• Duplicate Prevention

• Zero Runtime Dependencies

• Angular 22+ Compatibility
Every feature was implemented with performance and simplicity in mind.
Easy Installation
Getting started requires only one command:
npm install @kudoengineer/toastConfigure the provider:
provideToast({
duration: 4000,
position: 'top-right'
});Render the component:
<ke-toaster />Show notifications anywhere in your application:
toast.success('Saved successfully');
toast.error('Something went wrong');
toast.warning('Please review your input');
toast.info('Application updated');The API is intentionally simple so developers can focus on building their applications instead of learning a complex notification framework.
Built with Modern Angular
Angular continues to evolve rapidly, and this package follows modern Angular development practices.
It is built using:

• Standalone Components

• Angular Signals

• Dependency Injection

• Tree-Shakable Design

• Modern Angular Build System
This ensures excellent performance while keeping bundle sizes small.
What I Learned
Publishing an open-source package taught me valuable lessons beyond writing code.
I learned how to:

• Structure an Angular library.

• Design a clean public API.

• Manage semantic versioning.

• Publish packages to npm.

• Write developer documentation.

• Think from the perspective of library users instead of application developers.
Open-source development requires attention to usability, documentation, and long-term maintenance — not just functionality.
What’s Next?
The toast package is only the first step.
My long-term vision is to build a complete Angular ecosystem under KudoEngineer, including reusable libraries such as:

• @kudoengineer/forms

• @kudoengineer/table

• @kudoengineer/dialog

• @kudoengineer/auth

• @kudoengineer/utils

• @kudoengineer/rxjs
The goal is to provide developers with production-ready tools that are easy to integrate and maintain.
Final Thoughts
Open source is about sharing knowledge and helping the developer community grow together.
Publishing @kudoengineer/toast is an important milestone in my journey as a Full Stack Developer and marks the beginning of many more open-source contributions.
I welcome feedback, feature requests, and community contributions that can help improve this library.
Happy Coding! 🚀
